exclusion_detail: Lead Lu AF27139 (1): 4-chlorobenzaldehyde + nitromethane gives nitroolefin 19, morpholine addition gives 20, Zn/HCl reduction gives racemic diamine 21, resolution with N-acetyl-L-leucine (then free-basing) gives 22, T3P coupling with thiazole acid 23 gives 1: at least 5 reactions, and acid 23's own preparation is in the SI (Scheme S1), not available here, adding more.

lead.label: 1 (Lu AF27139)
lead.why: Title and abstract: 'the novel rodent-active and CNS-penetrant P2X7 receptor antagonist Lu AF27139'; the single compound the paper characterises.

notes: Only one compound is made in the synthesis section. No SI text file was in the bundle, so the route to acid 23 could not be checked; the 5-reaction minimum counts 23 as bought.
